repository_policy: All six graph repositories including Airflow; prioritize underrepresented repositories in each category

rule.reason: User-requested correction after Phase 1B failed: repository sharing is not primary-subject leakage.
rule.normalization: Unicode text casefold and whitespace collapse; paths normalize backslashes; commit prefixes match at >=7 characters
rule.scope: Files, issue/PR numbers and fragments are repository-scoped; commit hashes and developer identities are global.
rule.limitations: Human subjects lack annotations; only identifiable literal subjects can be checked. Not proof of semantic/paraphrase disjointness.
